title: FRK's Ancient Armors
description: Adds a bunch of mysterious and Ancient armors
body: # 📋What is this Mod **FRK's Ancient Armors** adds new, mysterious, and ancient armor to the game. These armors are generally magical and mystical, which is beneficial to players. Magical armors generally grant the player special effects. All armors can be crafted and operated without any problems. # 🛡️Armors ## Bone Armor Did you want to be an unloved skeleton? This is possible with this armor. Rarity: Common ## Wither Bone Armor Made from the remains of a Wither skeleton, this armor protects you from Wither magic. Rarity = Epic ## Warrior Armor This armor is designed to be worn by the greatest warrior who has ever known, meaning it's for you. Rarity = Uncommon ## Ancient Guardian Armor This armor was crafted by a sorcerer, inspired by ancient guardians. It makes you virtually invincible in water. Rarity = Mystic ## Old Wizard Armor A legendary armor found in an old wizard's storeroom. Rarity = Legendary ## Cursed Knight Armor Great power, but it is fraught with certain curses. Rarity = Mystic ## Lord Of Monsters Armor You are the king of all monsters, but you also share a common weakness. Rarity = Legendary # 📷Gallery ### Bone Armor ![Bone Armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/32ed57de1d19a08afd6e93920a4ead1f1a862323.png) ### Wither Bone Armor ![Wither Bone Armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/27e9bd392c959624db5e6dca174a469ead87d6ab.png) ### Warrior Armor ![Warrior Armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8131651b4967827f56aa56001486945d3b4fc1c8.png) ### Ancient Guardian Armor ![Ancient Guardian Armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/30b6b8df758644af31e3ce6724a70ed946b4319b.png) ### Old Wizard Armor ![Old Wizard](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/45fb990069e3e34cefc427b9940706e4a5c41ac9.png) ### Cursed Knight Armor ![Cursed Knight](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/108114dc9ad744840a9f03ac5050ae2d77ec6727_0.webp) ### Lord Of Monsters Armor ![lord](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a852b2c3e84735e980cbae7748ed49f1290f5f86.png)
